Emit a verdict as an orchestra manifest

Source: R/manifest.R
quorum_manifest.Rd

Builds the orchestra_manifest the rest of the orchestra reads from a quorum_verdict(): the contributions table as the payload, the status, the carried lens, the action, the independence weights and the independence caveat in the typed summary, and the grounding token the consensus earned.

Usage

quorum_manifest(verdict)

Arguments

verdict

A quorum_verdict().

Value

An orchestraManifest::orchestra_manifest, or a quorum_abstention() when the installed contract has no "consensus" target to emit into.

Details

The grounding rule is stricter than the lenses'. The consensus is stamped grounded only when at least one contributing lens is grounded and data_independence was not declared FALSE; lenses that agree because they read the same upstream fact corroborate the reading, not the world, and the manifest says so by carrying the unverified token instead.

See also

quorum(), quorum_verdict().

Examples

fit_fn <- function(spec, data, ...) {
  quorum_draws(list(`(Intercept)` = stats::rnorm(200L)),
               source = "example")
}
one <- quorum_lens("one", "example", fit_fn,
                   c(sampler = "a", objective = "b", priors = "c",
                     data_prep = "d"))
two <- quorum_lens("two", "example", fit_fn,
                   c(sampler = "w", objective = "x", priors = "y",
                     data_prep = "z"))
v <- quorum(list(one, two), policy = quorum_policy(c("one", "two")))
quorum_manifest(v)
